test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No Improvement'.**

__Many battles was__ fought on the soil of India.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Many a battle was'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part in the given sentence is erroneous.
 
• Here, **'Many a battle was' **should be used instead of** 'Many battles was'.**
 
• Only **Option 1 **makes a cohered sentence because as per the subject-verb agreement rule** 'Many a' **should be followed by **a singular noun** and **helping verb. **
 
• The given sentence would have been correct had there been '**were**' in place of '**was**'.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** ***Many a battle was** fought on the soil of India.*
